body:
Fixed a real bug (prwatch/runner.go hardcoded Source:"prnewswire" regardless of Client config) via new RunnerConfig.SourceName. Threaded real source name end to end: PressReleaseDiscovered.Source -> BodyFetchedEvent.Source -> SourceDocument.SourceProvider -> DocSummary.SourceProvider -> GET /v1/press-releases/{ticker}?provider=. Wrote docs/CONTENT_TYPE_TAXONOMY.md answering the founder's content-hierarchy question directly from real code (SourceType is the real, existing, flat content-type field; SourceProvider is the new subtype). Honest limitation: no working BusinessWire scraper -- businesswire.com 403s this session's fetch tooling, RSS needs a subscriber token, flagged not faked. go build/test clean. Commit f70de47.

⚓ ☃
title: S233: real press-release provider/subtype (prtype) end to end + content-type taxonomy doc
